Your job:
1. Read nollama.py in the working directory and find ALL command-line flags registered via argparse's `add_argument` calls. Do not modify anything. Just report findings.

<task_result>
# Full audit report — NoLlama CLI flags (`nollama.py`, `parse_args()`, lines 6682–6833)

## 1. Complete flag list (34 flags, all long-form, no short forms, no positionals)

| # | Flag | Type / action | One-line description |
|---|------|---------------|----------------------|
| 1 | `--version` | `action="version"` | Print `NoLlama <version>` and exit |
| 2 | `--model-dir` | str, default `model/` | Primary model directory |
| 3 | `--device` | str, default `auto` | Device for primary model: NPU, GPU, CPU, or auto |
| 4 | `--npu-platform` | str, default None | Override NPU_PLATFORM plugin value (e.g. 3720 Meteor Lake/Arrow Lake, 4000 Lunar Lake) instead of reading `DEVICE_ARCHITECTURE`; pins the resolved architecture so the NPU compiler never sees AUTO_DETECT |
| 5 | `--gpu-model-dir` | str, default None | Secondary GPU model directory (enables dual mode: NPU chat + GPU vision/LLM) |
| 6 | `--port` | int, default 8000 | OpenAI API port |
| 7 | `--ollama-port` | int, default 11434 | Ollama API port (0 disables it entirely) |
| 8 | `--max-dim` | int, default 768 | Max image dimension before resize |
| 9 | `--embed-model-dir` | str, default None | Text-embedding model dir (OpenVINO IR); enables `/v1/embeddings` and Ollama's `/api/embed` |
| 10 | `--embed-device` | str, default `CPU` | Device for the embedding model (CPU, GPU; never the NPU) |
| 11 | `--embed-name` | str, default None | Name to advertise the embedding model under (default: its directory name) |
| 12 | `--embed-max-length` | int, default 0 | Truncate embedding inputs to N tokens (0 = no truncation) |
| 13 | `--embed-batch-size` | int, default 16 | Texts per pipeline call (0 = no limit) |
| 14 | `--embed-threads` | int, default 0 | INFERENCE_NUM_THREADS for the embedding model (0 = OpenVINO default; CPU-only) |
| 15 | `--whisper-dir` | str, default None | Whisper model directory (enables `/v1/audio/transcriptions`) |
| 16 | `--whisper-device` | str, default `CPU` | Device for Whisper: CPU, GPU or NPU (NPU runs base/small; medium crashes NPU 4) |
| 17 | `--whisper-min-spread` | float, default WHISPER_MIN_SPREAD_DB | Skip Whisper on clips whose loud-to-quiet spread is under DB (0 disables) |
| 18 | `--idle-timeout` | int, default None | Idle-unload timeout in seconds (default 1800 = 30 min; 0 disables unloading, recommended for agent use, auto-enables `--prewarm`) |
| 19 | `--gpu-keepalive` | int, default GPU_KEEPALIVE_SEC, metavar SEC | Seconds of idle before a **discrete** GPU slot gets a 1-token ping to stay resident (0 disables; integrated GPUs do not evict) |
| 20 | `--log-file` | str, default None, metavar PATH | Also append the console output to this file (timings, warnings, tracebacks) |
| 21 | `--debug` | `store_true` | Log every inbound API request (method, path, User-Agent, body) and the raw model output of every tool turn before parsing |
| 22 | `--vscode-compat` | `store_true` | Report an Ollama-shaped version (VSCODE_OLLAMA_VERSION) on `/api/version` so VS Code's Ollama client accepts the server |
| 23 | `--vscode-ollama-version` | str, default VSCODE_OLLAMA_VERSION, metavar X.Y.Z | Version to report under `--vscode-compat` (raise it if VS Code demands a newer Ollama) |
| 24 | `--no-prompt-cache` | `store_true` | Disable prefix (KV) caching on GPU/CPU LLM slots (caching is on by default) |
| 25 | `--ignore-ir-version` | `store_true` | Load a model whose IR was exported by a newer OpenVINO than the installed runtime (refused by default) |
| 26 | `--gpu-large-alloc` | `store_true` | Let one GPU buffer exceed the device per-allocation cap (needed only when a request dies with "Exceeded max size of memory object allocation") |
| 27 | `--cache-size-gb` | int, default None | KV-cache pool size in GB when prefix caching is on (default: auto per device; a number pins it) |
| 28 | `--prewarm` | str, default None, metavar FILE | Prefill a saved agent prompt at startup so the first turn is a cache hit (auto-enabled as `prewarm-<port>.json` when `--idle-timeout 0`; implies `--idle-timeout 0`) |
| 29 | `--no-prewarm` | `store_true` | Disable the automatic prewarm that `--idle-timeout 0` turns on |
| 30 | `--think-in-content` | `store_true` | Legacy wire shape: keep `<think>...</think>` inside the assistant content (default is reasoning_content) |
| 31 | `--tool-template` | choices `ours`/`native`, default `ours` | How tool turns are rendered on GPU/CPU LLM slots (OpenAI endpoint): `ours` speaks Qwen3-Coder XML to every model; `native` renders the model's own chat template |
| 32 | `--offload-ratio` | int, default 0, metavar PCT | Stream PCT% of MoE expert weights from disk instead of keeping them GPU-resident (OpenVINO 2026.3+ disk offload; GPU slots only; 1–99; requires XMX-capable Intel GPU) |
| 33 | `--scan` | `nargs="*"`, default None, metavar DIR | Report what each model directory actually contains (name, precision, architecture, integrity) and exit; searches the NoLlama dir and `~/models` by default, or the given directories |
| 34 | `--backend` | choices `auto`/`genai`/`optimum`, default `auto` | Runtime for LLM/VLM slots: openvino_genai pipelines (`genai`), optimum-intel python runtime (`optimum`), or pick per model (`auto`) |

Re-verified just now: exactly 34 `add_argument` calls, all strings start with `--`.

## 2. Flags NOT mentioned in docs/API.md or README.md

**Confirmed exact, 9 flags** (each verified by searching both files for the string and for bare-name prose forms like `idle_timeout`, `max dim`, `ignore ir`, `tool template`, `log file`, `vscode ollama`, `npu platform`):

- `--version` — only hits in the docs are the `/api/version` endpoint (API.md line 28), provenance "versions" (API.md line 416) and non-"version" false-positives ("conversion"); the flag itself appears nowhere.
- `--npu-platform`
- `--max-dim`
- `--log-file`
- `--vscode-ollama-version` — "vscode" appears once in API.md (line 30, `--vscode-compat` usage); the version knob is absent.
- `--ignore-ir-version`
- `--gpu-large-alloc`
- `--tool-template` — "tool template"/"tool_template" prose absent.
- `--backend` — API.md line 87 has only the prose "caching backend" (describing an IR property, not the flag); `--backend` appears nowhere.

Every other flag is documented: `--model-dir`, `--device`, `--gpu-model-dir`, `--port`, `--ollama-port`, `--debug`, `--vscode-compat`, `--idle-timeout`, `--cache-size-gb`, `--no-prompt-cache`, `--prewarm`, `--no-prewarm`, `--think-in-content`, `--offload-ratio`, `--scan`, `--embed-model-dir`, `--embed-device`, `--embed-name`, `--embed-max-length`, `--embed-batch-size`, `--embed-threads`, `--whisper-dir`, `--whisper-device`, `--whisper-min-spread` (all in API.md), plus `--gpu-keepalive` (README.md line 154, only documentation of that flag). Total documented: 25; total: 34; missing: 9. ✓ (34 − 9 = 25.)

**Short forms:** none exist. No flag has a single-dash alias, so there is no short-form-missing-while-long-form-is-documented case — no `-p`, `-i`, `-v`, etc. to report.

## 3. Positional arguments

**None.** No `nargs="*"` exists outside `--scan` (which consumes optional directory arguments but is itself a `--` long option, not a positional). There is no third positional argument registered (the argv array beyond options is never used for anything), so `nollama.py [DIRS]` is never the interface — use `--scan [DIRS...]`.

One consistency note: README.md line 41 ("every flag: docs/API.md") and line 166 (API.md covers "all CLI flags") overstate the coverage — 9 documented-elsewhere flags above aside, the nine missing flags have no docs anywhere.
</task_result>
</task>
